title: Nano Payment Instrument
description: A payment instrument for Nano (XNO), a feeless settlement asset with deterministic block confirmation. The business issues a unique receive address per checkout, which is the binding; the confirmed send block to that address is the proof of payment. This instrument carries no `credential`: there is no PAN, network token or other bearer secret. Handler rules that JSON Schema cannot express (single-use claim, confirmation, amount mismatch) are defined in the Nano Payment Instrument handler specification.

type.description: Indicates this is a Nano payment instrument.

receive_address.description: The Nano account address the business issued for this checkout, unique to it (e.g., derived at a checkout-index path). Business-issued and published in checkout responses; platforms do not submit it. When verifying `settlement_block`, the business MUST compare against the address it issued for this checkout, re-derived from the checkout session or looked up in its own records, and MUST NOT use a `receive_address` carried in a request. If a submitted instrument carries a `receive_address` that differs from the issued address, the business MUST reject the instrument.

amount_raw.description: The exact amount due for this checkout in raw, the smallest Nano unit (1 XNO = 10^30 raw), as a decimal integer string. Business-issued with `receive_address` and subject to the same rule: the business MUST compare the settlement block's amount against the amount it issued, MUST NOT use an `amount_raw` carried in a request, and MUST reject a submitted instrument whose `amount_raw` differs from the issued amount.

settlement_block.description: The hash of the Nano send block that pays this checkout, submitted by the platform after the send. It is the proof of payment, not a credential. It proves payment only when the business, using its own view of the Nano ledger, finds a confirmed send block whose destination (`link`, read as an account) equals the `receive_address` the business issued for this checkout and whose amount equals the issued `amount_raw`. A block hash settles at most one checkout.

display.description: Display information for this Nano payment instrument.

address_short.description: Shortened display form of the receive address (prefix and first 6 characters, '...', last 6 characters). Presentational only.

description.description: An optional rich text description of the Nano payment to display to the user (e.g., 'Nano (XNO), feeless, instant settlement').
